_readme: Known classes that a page uses and nothing defines, recorded 2026-08-31 when the
classes gate landed. This file is a RATCHET, like coldopen.json: an entry here is
acknowledged debt the gate tolerates; any use NOT listed here fails the build. Fix a
class, remove its entry. Never add an entry to silence a failure on a NEW page - a
new page starts with zero debt. The per-page definitions of these differ, which is
why they were not bulk-promoted to _shared the night they were found.
